description:
A member of Perilous Siege.
Unlike the squad leader, D, she possesses a gentler sense of justice.
She won't kill a target—even a villain—if they have done enough good to atone for their actions.

costumes.name: Undercover
costumes.description:
K costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: Why do you keep bothering me? Got a death wish or something?!
Do I look like a pushover to you?! Huh?!
Tch... I'm only putting up with this because it's you. Got it?
If you've got something to say, then spit it out.

Everyone else just pisses me off.
But with you... it's like my head clears.
You call me over here, and now you're doing something else? Hey!
You've got some nerve to call me here and then run off to do something else.
If you wanna rest, just go to the hotel.
There aren't any humans here. That's why I like this place. Oh, right, I forgot you're a human.
Is there anyone you'd like to bump off?
I'm in a surly mood. If there's anyone you want offed, feel free to tell me.
Now I feel like I can cut loose.
There's not a bomb inside or anything, is there?
Whenever I see you lately, I get so flustered and... Ugh, I don't even know! I'm not even acting like myself!
If there were more humans like you around, life might be more tolerable.
Wh... Why do you always make people worry about you?!
I briefed myself on the mission earlier.
Time to take out the trash.
I'm gonna roast you all alive!
